# AJ: Custom Website Design & Development

> AJ is a web designer and developer with 3+ years of professional agency experience and 40+ websites worked on for agencies and international businesses. AJ builds custom websites using AI-assisted workflows (Claude Code, Codex) alongside hands-on design and development experience, in Webflow, Framer or Astro depending on the client's needs. Design decisions, implementation review, testing and delivery are done by AJ.

## Pages
- [Home](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/): Custom websites, faster delivery and cost-effective development; workflow, target timelines, process, content editing and ownership, services, projects, testimonials and FAQ.
- [Astro Development & Migrations](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/astro/): Astro + Sanity builds and migrations from Webflow, Framer, WordPress and Wix; platform comparison; web app features and automations; SEO and AEO setup.
- [Projects](https://angelicojohn.github.io/angelico-portfolio/projects/): Websites built in Astro, Webflow and Framer.

## Services
- Custom website design and development
- Website redesign and modernisation
- Website automation and integrations (newer service): forms, CRMs, bookings, n8n workflows
- Ongoing optimisation and support

## Target timelines (not guarantees; counted from when content and access are ready)
- Landing pages: 3-5 business days
- Small business websites: 1-2 weeks
- Larger custom websites: 2-4 weeks
- Advanced projects and integrations: scoped per project
